A ship was found drifting at sea in 1872 — full sails, dry stores, thread still on the sewing machine — and not a single person aboard. #ForgottenAndFound The official investigation ruled out violence entirely, and the one mechanical clue investigators actually found on deck is stranger, and more specific, than most retellings of this story let on.

This video uses AI narration and AI-generated illustrations.

Sources: Smithsonian Magazine — "An Abandoned Merchant Ship Was Discovered Floating in the Atlantic in 1872. The Mystery of Its Missing Crew Was Never Solved"; History.com — "The Mystery of the Mary Celeste"; Encyclopaedia Britannica — "Mary Celeste"; Royal Museums Greenwich — "The Mystery of the Mary Celeste" (Andrew Choong Han Lin).

#ForgottenAndFound #MaryCeleste #UnsolvedMystery #MaritimeHistory #GhostShip
